notes.title: Released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36609096/fd6c0d3c31dc91cb32790ee04978d99276510e15.png[/img]
After almost 3 years of development Wildemist Isle has been released its been a fun and great learning experience. I am quite proud and happy with the way the game plays. If by chance you find any bugs you can report them on my website bug report is at bottom here: https://silverswoopgames.blogspot.com/ it has a place for email because it was the fastest way for me to setup a bug report system I won't be using your email for anything it is suppose to be a contact form.

notes.title: Release is Due!
notes.content: So after almost 3 years of development I am finally done developing Wildemist Isle. I have 36.4 hrs on steam playing my game and that doesn't count the 2 and a half years I developed without steam integration. So I am pretty sure all major bugs have been removed there may a few minor ones left but nothing that should break the game. I personally can't find any bugs right now and that is why I have sent it to steam for release approval. Should hopefully be releasing this Friday September the 10th but all depends on if it gets approved on time. Its been a long hard road but a great learning experience I am very happy and excited about the game its more than I had originally planned to do. I find the game still fun to play after 3 years of developing and testing. I really hope you are interested and support me there is a few hours of gameplay to finish the game and you can always replay since you are given random starting items each time you start a new game you could have 1 of the first 4 items in all items. I have steam achievements implemented as well and working so you can also replay to try to 100% the game slay that unique boss or solve that puzzle you didn't when you first played. I hope you all enjoy the game as much as I do.

notes.title: We have entered!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36609096/bdb593cbf0a82cd76d269c7d400fa7d40886b8f4.jpg[/img]
Come try out our demo! It is a first person open world adventure card game. You explore the island doing quests for the villagers and fighting beats and creatures when outside the village. You fight the enemies by using your deck of cards. Your cards are decided by what weapons you have equipped what shield you have and what healing pack you are carrying. You have a limited amount of attack and item points, and each card has a cost so you need to be strategic in choosing your cards. Buy bread at the market or drink from wells to restore your health. Don't stay out in the mist too long or you may not come back.
